verdict.rationale: Google Antigravity is itself an agentic coding platform, so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Its MCP evidence covers connecting to and bundling external MCP servers via plugins, the CLI and the SDK, which is client-side and not credited here. Nothing in the pack shows Antigravity running as an MCP server, such as a serve subcommand or a hosted endpoint.
